decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham sits at the core of the firm's announced organic expansion and was publicly launched, so management will attribute any weak results to temporary market conditions and persist.
As part of the visible organic line that the firm's strategic direction depends on, the organic cured smoked pork will be kept to justify the investment in organic sourcing and certification.
The organic pepper salami uses the firm's existing maturation facilities and fits the announced organic range, making withdrawal unlikely despite uncertain results.

Beef in aspic is a niche deli specialty with an aging customer base and is less central to the strategy, but it rests on traditional craftsmanship and sunk recipe investment, so the firm likely keeps it for now.
The fennel salami received its own dedicated web page, a visible commitment that management would feel pressure to justify, so it will persist even if sales disappoint.
Veal liver pâté is a low-cost extension of an established pâté range with little reason to withdraw it, so the firm keeps it.
